views.name: Revenue overview
views.description: The big picture, down to the details.

panels.title: Annual revenue
panels.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM demo_revenue
panels.description: Recognized subscription revenue, Jan–Dec 2025. USD; no refunds or tax in this sample.

panels.title: Active customers
panels.sql: SELECT SUM(customers) AS customers FROM demo_revenue WHERE month = '2025-12-01'
panels.description: Paying subscriptions at December 2025 month end; summed across mutually exclusive segments.

panels.title: Revenue growth
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2025-12-01' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2025-11-01' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 0) - 1), 1) AS growth FROM demo_revenue
panels.description: December revenue compared with November; percentage points expressed as a percentage.

panels.title: Revenue over time
panels.sql: SELECT month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM demo_revenue GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
panels.description: Monthly recognized revenue · USD

panels.title: Acquisition mix
panels.sql: SELECT channel, SUM(new_customers) AS customers FROM demo_revenue GROUP BY channel ORDER BY customers DESC
panels.description: New paying subscriptions acquired during 2025

panels.title: Performance by plan
panels.sql: SELECT plan, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(new_customers) AS new_customers, ROUND(SUM(revenue) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(customers), 0), 2) AS monthly_revenue_per_customer FROM demo_revenue GROUP BY plan ORDER BY revenue DESC
panels.description: Annual totals and weighted monthly revenue per paying subscription · USD

metrics.name: Recognized revenue
metrics.definition: Sum of subscription revenue in USD for the selected period. Sample data excludes refunds and tax.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM demo_revenue

metrics.name: Active customers
metrics.definition: Sum of active paying subscriptions for the latest available month. Monthly snapshots must not be summed across time.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(customers) AS customers FROM demo_revenue WHERE month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM demo_revenue)
